name: India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
key_benefits: Elimination of tariffs on over 90% of traded goods between India and Japan, including significant duty concessions for marine products.
origin_criteria: Product specific rules (PSR) typically require a Change in Tariff Classification (CTC) at the 6-digit heading level or a minimum qualifying value content (QVC) of 35%.

specific_regulations.marine_products: Duty concessions apply to various marine products, with tariffs phased out to 0% for shrimp and other seafood. Must comply with Japan's Food Sanitation Act and undergo quarantine inspections.
specific_regulations.pharmaceuticals: Fast-track registration for generic drugs in Japan for Indian manufacturers that meet PMDA standards.
